title: Teenage Robert Temple helps Arthur Young draft The Reflexive Universe
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Teenage Robert Temple helps Arthur Young draft The Reflexive Universe, about 1960s at Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he actually helped Arthur write the first draft of the reflexive universe.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher and interviewer who studies psychic phenomena, told podcast host Jesse Michels that the writer Robert Temple, as a teenager in 1960s Philadelphia, worked with the inventor and philosopher Arthur Young. Mishlove says Temple actually helped Young write the first draft of The Reflexive Universe, Young's book on consciousness and the cosmos. He tells it as a little-known link between two figures from the fringes of science.
